rejection_policy: Reject if: license unclear, weights missing/fake, unverifiable claims, broken repository, incompatible architecture, or hardware too small. DO NOT install rejected entries.

rejected_models.name: Kronos-large
rejected_models.detail: Model card lists Kronos-large as 'not yet publicly available'. Do not pretend it is downloadable.

rejected_models.name: PyPI 'kronos' 0.2.2
rejected_models.detail: PyPI 'kronos' is a Django cron-scheduler by jgorset (2011), NOT the financial K-line foundation model. The real Kronos installs from GitHub shiyu-coder/Kronos.

rejected_models.name: Aegis legacy 'Kronos-Base-v1.0' (models/kronos_small.pt from kronos_engine/)
rejected_models.detail: The legacy engine builds a randomly-initialized custom transformer, saves it to models/kronos_small.pt, and labels it 'Kronos'. It is NOT a download of NeoQuasar/Kronos-small weights, so it must NOT be described as a pretrained foundation model. Preserved only as the existing local engine; excluded from pretrained-model claims and from the model tournament weights.

rejected_models.name: Forex-specific / EURUSD-specific / XAUUSD-specific pretrained checkpoints
rejected_models.detail: No official, license-clear, weight-complete checkpoint verified for EURUSD/XAUUSD this session. HF tags alone are not evidence. Skips integration until independently verified.

rejected_models.name: FinText financial models
rejected_models.detail: No official weight release verified this session.

rejected_models.name: FinGPT-Forecaster
rejected_models.detail: AI4Finance-Foundation/FinGPT exists; forecaster weights and license require further verification before install.

rejected_models.name: Sundial / TiRex / Time-MoE / MOMENT / Lag-Llama / Timer / Timer-XL / Granite TTM / PatchTST / PatchTSMixer
rejected_models.detail: All are plausible candidates (Section 7 of the directive) but their licenses, checkpoint sizes and this 6GB-GPU compatibility were not fully verified in this session. They are catalogued as INVESTIGATE, not installed.

rejected_models.name: FinGPT (AI4Finance-Foundation)
rejected_models.detail: FinGPT model pages (e.g. fingpt-sentiment-llama3-8b) return HTTP 401 without Hugging Face authentication; weights are gated and built on Llama-3 (Meta community license). Cannot freely verify checkpoint -> not auto-downloaded. Sentiment layer uses Apache-2.0 FinBERT instead.

rejected_models.name: patchtst
rejected_models.detail: checkpoint 'ibm/patchtst-etth1-pretrain' has no pretrained forecast head (2 random head params, e.g. head.projection.bias); randomly-initialised head is NOT a pretrained forecaster

rejected_models.name: ttm_r1_r2
rejected_models.detail: no GraniteTimeSeries/TTM class in transformers 5.14.1; needs `granite-tsfm`
